title: Audio Dashboard — Example Read-Along
heading: Audio Dashboard — Example
subtitle: Play a card (or tap any word) to READ and LISTEN together — the teleprompter highlights each word in real time from real STT-after-TTS whisper timing.
railLabel: example arc — tap any node to fly there
_note_reference: `reference` is a PLACEHOLDER — use ben-c1 for the host and replace examplechannel-c4s with <expert>-c4s from GOLEMS_EXPERT_VOICE (see NARRATIONLAYER_PROFILES_FILE) or a direct path to a reference .wav clip. Voice clones are machine-local and are not shipped with the skill. A scene may instead carry `audioWav` (existing WAV) for a daemon-free bring-your-own-audio run.
